title: Sage chat — readability family

metrics.reason: informational alongside the gated pass_rate — each case already asserts its own maxGrade via assessReadability(), so median_grade is a distribution stat over only 3 cases today, not an independent gate

notes: Promotes the existing `readability` family of scripts/sage-chat-harness.mjs (3 cases today, each asserting a per-case maxGrade via assessReadability()) to a gated numeric metric. Spawned unmodified via `--families=readability --provider=openrouter --model=google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`. pass_rate floor 1.0 mirrors the existing UI-copy readability gate's zero-tolerance posture; median_grade is informational (no floor) since it is a distribution stat over only 3 cases today. Since 2026-10-15 the harness calls production's model, google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite, through OpenRouter (OPENROUTER_API_KEY), because the repository's GEMINI_API_KEY secret was rejected by Google. The fixture is synthetic, so OpenRouter never sees student data (docs/runbooks/openrouter-test-bench.md). OpenRouter cannot pass production's Gemini safetySettings, so replies are the model on OpenRouter's defaults. In CI, which has no .env.local to refill it, the harness runs with an empty GEMINI_API_KEY, so it cannot call Google directly.
